name: Bikács (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, light blue at the hoist and white at the fly, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Bikács (a blue and white shield with a bunch of grapes, a crescent, a fleur-de-lis and waves) below the name BIKÁCS in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
